data.long_meaning: Bikesh is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Bhagavat', meaning 'God'. The name Bikesh signifies a person who is the conqueror of the gods. In Hindu mythology, this name is associated with Lord Vishnu, who is the preserver of the universe. The name Bikesh carries the meaning “Conqueror of Gods” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bikesh usually hope their child will grow to embody conqueror of gods and live with faith, good character and purpose.
